profile.headline: AI Software Engineer @ Firefly Aerospace
profile.summary: BS in Aerospace Engineering with many years of work experience. Most of my work is with AI/ML systems and doing aerospace research. I pride myself in my project management and strong software development skills. I enjoy flying and playing/watching sports. Go Ravens!

positions.title: AI Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: Cedar Park, Texas, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Designing and developing company wide AI solutions
- Deploying software solutions using AWS (Bedrock, ECS, Document DB, etc)
- Provide IT support to users trying to leverage AI solutions
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Strands · Docker · Python (Programming Language) · React Native

positions.locationName: College Station, Texas, United States · On-site

positions.title: Data Science/Software Senior
positions.description:
• Leading software development teams as main author/PI in proposal writing for SBIR and STTR contracts.
• Managing day-to-day operations, planning tasks, and researching AI/ML advancements.
• Developing embedded system solutions with AI inference capabilities (on edge) for detection and recognition tasks
• Training and developing custom AI/ML solutions using PyTorch/ONNX

positions.title: Data Science/Software Specialist

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: The Novel and Unconventional Aerospace Applications in Core Educational Disciplines focuses on finding new ways to apply knowledge gained in aerospace to different problems outside of the traditional scope. Currently I am working on the game “Space Traffic Jam!” and designing problems that can help second year students understand aerospace concepts.
